name: Layoutglut
author: AppGlut

sections.description:
Layoutglut provides custom layout solutions for your WooCommerce store. Build unique product pages, shop pages, and archive pages tailored to your brand.

Product Page Builder
* Create custom layouts for single product pages
* Multiple ready-to-use templates
* Live preview with demo mode
* Product gallery with image styling
* Apply to all or specific products
* Mobile responsive design

Shop Page Builder
* Custom layouts for the main shop page
* Configurable product grid and list views
* Enhanced filtering and sorting options
* Product display controls and pagination
* Mobile-responsive shop layouts

Archive Page Builder
* Custom layouts for category and tag archive pages
* Archive-specific product display options
* Enhanced breadcrumb navigation
* Mobile-optimized archive layouts

KEY FEATURES

  • Zero coding required — visual interface for everyone
  • Mobile responsive — looks great on all devices
  • Performance-optimized — lightweight and fast
  • Theme compatible — works with any WordPress theme
  • WooCommerce 3.0+ compatible
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended):
1. Go to WordPress admin → Plugins → Add New
2. Search for “Layoutglut”
3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
4. Navigate to Layoutglut in the admin menu to get started

Manual Installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file
2. Upload via WordPress admin → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
3. Or extract to /wp-content/plugins/layoutglut/ directory
4. Activate through the Plugins menu in WordPress

Requirements:
* WordPress 5.1+
* WooCommerce 3.0+
* PHP 7.4+
sections.faq:
Is coding knowledge required?

No. Layoutglut is designed for users of all skill levels with an intuitive visual interface.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. Layoutglut is performance-optimized and only loads assets when needed.

Does it work with all WooCommerce product types?

Yes. Simple, variable, grouped, and external/affiliate products are all supported.

Is the plugin mobile-responsive?

Yes. All layouts automatically adapt to tablets and smartphones.

Does it work with my existing theme?

Layoutglut is designed to work with any well-coded WordPress theme.
